01 / About

About & Résumé

Electrical Engineering student at Michigan State University (GPA 3.93, Dean's List), currently working as an Optics & Display Engineering Intern at Visteon Corporation, where the work centers on optical and thermal characterization of OLED displays and building out data-acquisition systems for a multi-supplier luminance degradation study. Outside of coursework, most weekends go toward hands-on builds — amplifiers, PCBs, motor controllers, anything that involves a soldering iron and a bit of stubbornness.

Now

Recently started tinkering with embedded C through an Arduino starter kit — learning to work with a breadboard from scratch and getting hands-on with thermistors, DC motors, passive and active buzzers, and 4-digit seven-segment displays along the way.
